evidence.title: GEOTHERMIX, LLC
evidence.excerpt: Recipient Name: GEOTHERMIX, LLC; Award Amount: 2521548.0; Start Date: 2022-09-01; Awarding Agency: Department of Energy; Awarding Sub Agency: Department of Energy; Description: THE OBJECTIVE OF THE PROJECT IS TO DEVELOP AND DEMONSTRATE IN THE FIELD, THE TECHNICAL AND COMMERCIAL FEASIBILITY OF THERMOELECTRIC GENERATORS TO HARVEST WASTE HEAT FROM EXISTING OIL AND GAS FACILITIES TO PRODUCE COMMERCIAL QUANTITIES OF ELECTRICAL POWER WITH A NEAR-ZERO CARBON FOOTPRINT. DURING THIS PILOT PROJECT, WE WILL HARNESS THE HEAT FROM THE PRODUCED GAS AT SUBRECIPIENT 1’S OIL AND GAS FACILITY IN ORDER TO PROVE THE VIABILITY OF OUR TECHNOLOGY TO COPRODUCE GEOTHERMAL ENERGY FROM OIL AND GAS WELLS.
